Synopsis:
Damays (and Nymessa) got dragged into a combat from another situation (ex.: the brains at the crash site, the bandits at the chapel). Nymessa plays this AD when the combat ends and while she returns to the cage, if Damays is dead (otherwise Damays is the one doing the AD).

Cluster Contexts:
- CHA_LaezelRecruitment_AD_ReturnAnyCombat2.json: Damays (and Nymessa) got dragged into a combat from another situation (ex.: the brains at the crash site, the bandits at the chapel). Damays plays this AD when the combat ends, while he returns to the cage.
- LOW_MurderTribunal_AD_Valeria_Combat.json: Valeria enters combat at the Murder Tribunal. She will say this AD on her first combat turn.
- LOW_BhaalTemple_AD_AwakenAbductee.json: This dialog will play in 3 different circumstances.1) Players unlocked the abductee stealthily before the dialog with Orin. Which would trigger a dialog with Orin. After that dialog with Orin, the abductee will wake up and play this AD. Combat than begins. Yenna would run away, companions will join players as a follower.2) Players have entered combat with Orin, and during combat, they unlock the abductee. In which case they will awaken immediately and play this AD. Yenna runs away, companion joins as follower.3) Player have defeated Orin and unlock the altar, in which case they are all in relatively safe enviroment. Yenna would not need to run away, companion would not need to join as follower.During combat, players attempt to rescue the victim. When the players unlock the altar, the victim is awakened and plays this AD as they are awakened.If the victim is a player companion, they join combat as an AI NPC.If the victim is Yenna she runs away.

- LOW_HouseOfHope_AD_RaphaelGone.json: Narrator AD that is played after the combat with Raphael is finished. It will be played only if there's no one else to start the dialogue with

context: Damays and Nymessa were pulled out of another scene (for example the crash-site brains or the bandits at the chapel) when combat started, and the fight has just ended. The lines occur as they are returning a captured creature (the "toad"/abductee) to its cage — Nymessa is voicing the return/watch comment in these examples. Normally Damays would deliver this after combat if he’s alive and escorting the captive; if Damays is dead, Nymessa performs the ad instead. These short quips emphasize that the rescue/captive situation is still being secured and that they don’t want the toad/abductee escaping.
